side_effect_claim: All negative controls produce zero side effects; lost-response replay returns the original operation and produces one side effect.
limitations: Pure in-memory reference model; no DB, broker, cryptographic signer, external authorization service or browser is exercised.
The mock sink models fencing, current tenant permission, idempotency and mutation/result persistence as an atomic transition.
Source receipts and tenant identity are trusted model inputs, not cryptographically authenticated production artifacts.
This does not demonstrate exactly-once delivery for arbitrary external sinks.
